t: This is The Biltmore Mayfair, a five-star hotel at 44 Grosvenor Square. It was renovated from late 2017 and reopened on the ninth of September 2019. The building was designed by Richard Seifert, a Swiss-British architect best known for two famous London towers: the NatWest Tower, once the tallest building in the United Kingdom, and Centre Point. So you're standing at a Mayfair hotel by the same hand that shaped some of the city's most recognisable skyline.
